_doc: AI Story script (survival). This file scaffolds the 7-beat structure. The daily-shorts-pipeline routine fills in 'text', 'keywords', 'title', 'description' fields at production time, then runs check_script_structure.py to lint, then make_audio_elevenlabs.py + build_visuals_track.py.

beats.label: hook
beats.purpose_hint: Hit Day N + escalation in ≤12 words
beats.text: Day 1 of being snowed in. I'm not alone out here.

beats.label: setup
beats.purpose_hint: Frame what's happening at this moment
beats.text: The storm hit Tuesday. By dawn the road was buried, the cell tower was dead, and the wood stove was my only heat.

beats.label: build
beats.purpose_hint: Add stakes — what makes today different
beats.text: I rationed coffee. Split firewood. Three days, I thought. Wait it out. Then I went outside for more wood.
beats.visual_style_hint: tension shot, dutch angle, close detail

beats.label: mid_anchor
beats.purpose_hint: Discovery, threat reveal, or escalation moment
beats.text: And I saw them. Fresh boot prints in the snow. They weren't mine.
beats.visual_style_hint: HERO SHOT — Pika clip preferred, dramatic reveal

beats.label: expand
beats.purpose_hint: What does this mean for tomorrow / survival
beats.text: Size thirteen. I'm an eleven. And they led away from the cabin, which means at some point, someone was inside while I slept.

beats.label: payoff
beats.purpose_hint: Resolution beat OR cliffhanger for Day N+1
beats.text: I'm checking every window, every lock, every closet. Nothing's missing. Nothing's been moved. They just wanted me to know.
beats.visual_style_hint: wide environmental shot, change of light

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Day 2 tomorrow. If I make it.
beats.visual_style_hint: fade-to-loop frame, same composition as hook

case_title: Day 1: I'm not alone out here
character_continuity_hint: [Same protagonist across episodes. Default description: tall man late 30s, weathered face, dark hair, faded blue jacket, dirt-smudged. Include in every Flux prompt to maintain visual continuity. Override per-character in the queue entry's 'Protagonist:' field.]
description_lead: Day 1 of being trapped at a remote cabin during a blizzard. Then he found the footprints.
hook_template: Day [N] of [scenario]. Today I [escalation in 5-7 words].
spoken_text: Day 1 of being snowed in. I'm not alone out here. The storm hit Tuesday. By dawn the road was buried, the cell tower was dead, and the wood stove was my only heat. I rationed coffee. Split firewood. Three days, I thought. Wait it out. Then I went outside for more wood. And I saw them. Fresh boot prints in the snow. They weren't mine. Size thirteen. I'm an eleven. And they led away from the cabin, which means at some point, someone was inside while I slept. I'm checking every window, every lock, every closet. Nothing's missing. Nothing's been moved. They just wanted me to know. Day 2 tomorrow. If I make it.
title: Day 1: I'm not alone out here
visual_palette: muted earth tones, high contrast, slightly desaturated, single light source
